en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
Hello everyone! Today, we’re releasing another update to Harper, the grammar checker designed to get out of your way. Since our last release, we’ve been focused almost entirely on fixing some pretty critical bugs.
In our Desktop app, we’ve resolved some problems with memory management when your Mac went to sleep. You should no longer see “Out of Memory” error messages after you wake your Mac up in the morning. We've also fixed some pretty horrendous problems with our setup process. It should now be far more intuitive. We hope to make it prettier in the future, too.
In our Chrome Extension, we paid special attention to our users who write in Ellipsus or in WordPress’ Gutenberg editor. Suggestions and highlights should now start ending up in the right places.
Finally, as with all our releases, we made some miscellaneous improvements to our core grammar engine.
Hope you all have a great weekend, Elijah.
